source: Phase 10a bootstrap from Paul Ricard push runs; reconciled with driver checklist and raw baseline telemetry on 2026-09-07 for a prospective static pilot. Model validation remains pending.

zones.notes: Heavy first braking event after the start/finish straight. Reconciled 2026-09-07: checklist interpreted as an additional 120 m upstream of the original start, giving 240 m before braking. Raw baseline_01 laps 1-3 show full throttle and no brake near the new start. Capture margin is not a lift recommendation.

First brake of the T03-T07 sequence. Preserve the baseline_02 lap 13 T03-only mistake exclusion. On 2026-09-07 the driver confirmed an additional 75 m upstream capture margin (195 m before braking); baseline_01 laps 1-3 show full throttle and no brake near it. End extended 50 m per the original checklist, before the next brake reference at 1338.74 m. T05 validation-only coverage overlaps: never sum it with T03 for additive lap sanity. The approximate capture margin is not a recommended lift distance.
Small mid-sequence brake event kept for validation only in the first Paul Ricard bootstrap. Revisit only if controlled-random evidence later shows genuine local LICO value.
Exit-to-Mistral context. Held out of first-pass optimization because any lift here risks paying heavily on the long straight that follows.

Mistral chicane bootstrap candidate. Clear heavy braking event and high arrival speed make this one of the most important early Paul Ricard candidates. On 2026-09-07 the driver confirmed moving the existing start and LICO window 75 m earlier, to 195 m before the unchanged brake reference. This approximate capture margin remains provisional pending telemetry review; it is not a recommended lift distance. Rebuild derived passes, priors and models before use.
High-speed technical candidate entering the Beausset section. Keep in the first controlled-random roster, but expect more driver-variance than Spa.

Follow-on technical braking event after T11. Reconciled 2026-09-07 per driver checklist: start 100 m before brake, end 200 m after brake. Baseline_01 laps 1-3 include low/zero throttle near the new boundaries; this remains a coupled-section diagnostic requiring caution, not a validated isolated response. Preserve zero-throttle flags in readiness and model review.
Short late-lap candidate. Kept in the bootstrap roster because the braking event is distinct, but it should stay conservative until local evidence is stronger.

Final-corner braking event kept for validation only after two controlled-random runs. Driver review says T15 is not a viable LICO corner, and local varied-LICO data showed near-zero fuel gain with no meaningful distance variation.
